'''Desora''' was a [[Maiden of the Spear]] of the [[Musara]] [[Reyn]]. 

== Appearance ==
She had golden hair and liked to hide her smiles behind her hand.

== Activities ==
She was one of [[Rand al'Thor]]'s guards when he went to the Farm. She also escorted Rand when he went to [[Shadar Logoth]] to find the [[Waygate]] with [[Elder Haman]] and participated in the search for [[Liah]]. She was killed when she used her body as a shield to protect Rand, when [[Children of the Light]] tried to assassinate him.
